name: Bandon (southern Oregon coast: dunes, fescue and spruce forest)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Bandon Trails, Bandon OR: fine fescue fairways and greens in a lighter, yellower green than the pnw parkland turf; golden-tan dry fescue rough with a mown band along the fairways (rough_band_m); warm tan dune sand in the bunkers; dark tannin dune lakes; olive dune scrub and forest floor off the course. From the photos and the OSIP 2024 orthophoto in the GitHub release bandon-trails-data. Trees in assets-src/trees_bandon.py: Sitka spruce and Douglas fir, and wind-shaped shore pine. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
